name: GraphNode
src_typeComment: One node in a hand-placed waypoint graph — for open/irregular layouts where a uniform grid (see GridPathfinder) doesn't fit. Edge weight defaults to real-world distance, but can be overridden per edge for a cost that isn't physical distance (danger, terrain difficulty, a toll) — that override is what makes Dijkstra meaningfully different from just running A* on the same graph.

src_serialized.name: edges
src_serialized.tooltip: Nodes directly reachable from this one, with their traversal cost.

src_members.name: GetEdgeWeight
src_members.comment: DijkstraPathfinder already skips edges with a null target before ever calling this, but it's public API — guard directly rather than relying on every caller to check first.
